display.purpose: The Tally numeral on the call-out detail. The only text this large; nothing else uses it.

title.purpose: PageHeader H1 and every /prof/* page H1. The default page heading.

body.purpose: Default UI text, table cells, meta lines. cv05 + ss01 character variants on.

label.purpose: Field labels, hints, nav items, section labels (at 600 weight). Sentence case, no uppercase.

caption.purpose: Table headers, status pill text, disclaimers. Tab-bar labels drop to 11px.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: The only elevation in use. Every panel, table, and card: border-hairline + this.

shadows.name: button-primary-inset
shadows.purpose: 1px top highlight on the primary button for slight physicality. Not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Defined in globals.css but unreferenced by any shipped surface. Available primitive, not a documented role.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Defined in globals.css but unreferenced by any shipped surface. Available primitive, not a documented role.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Default duration for color/width transitions on buttons, inputs, nav, and the tally fill bar.

motion.name: ease-land
motion.purpose: Easing for the .fj-land landing highlight (620ms total: color arrives instantly, holds ~22%, fades).

motion.name: fj-land
motion.purpose: Landing highlight for a row/tally whose state just changed. Currently has no caller; staged for the SSE realtime wiring. prefers-reduced-motion removes it.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes .fj-land and all width/position transitions; state changes snap into place.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one azure action per surface. Server-action forms use the SubmitButton variant with a pendingLabel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.006em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-fg-onbrand, #fff); background: var(--color-brand, oklch(0.55 0.188 249)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12); transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-hover, oklch(0.48 0.188 249)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, oklch(0.6 0.19 249)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action alongside the primary; panel fill with a strong hairline edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, oklch(0.86 0.005 255)); border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.006em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.24 0.012 260)); background: var(--color-panel, #fff); transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, oklch(0.6 0.19 249)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Demoted action: no fill or border at rest. Used for 'Cancelar', inline 'Salvar', mobile 'Desistir'.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.006em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-fg-muted, oklch(0.46 0.01 260)); background: transparent; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.24 0.012 260)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, oklch(0.6 0.19 249)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Shared control class for Input/Textarea/Select. Border shifts to brand on focus with an inset 2px ring; no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, oklch(0.86 0.005 255)); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-panel, #fff); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: -0.006em; color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.24 0.012 260)); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-fg-subtle, oklch(0.6 0.008 255)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, oklch(0.6 0.19 249)); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: var(--color-brand, oklch(0.55 0.188 249)); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: The printed form of a domain enum. Fully round, soft-hue fill, solid-hue text, matching /25 border, optional leading dot. Tone is always semantic.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-pill-brand { background: var(--color-brand-soft, oklch(0.955 0.038 249)); color: var(--color-brand, oklch(0.55 0.188 249)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-brand, oklch(0.55 0.188 249)) 25%, transparent); } .ds-pill-neutral { background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); color: var(--color-fg-muted, oklch(0.46 0.01 260)); border-color: var(--color-hairline-strong, oklch(0.86 0.005 255)); } .ds-pill-pos { background: var(--color-pos-soft, oklch(0.955 0.04 150)); color: var(--color-pos, oklch(0.52 0.13 150)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-pos, oklch(0.52 0.13 150)) 25%, transparent); } .ds-pill-neg { background: var(--color-neg-soft, oklch(0.96 0.03 25)); color: var(--color-neg, oklch(0.53 0.2 25)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-neg, oklch(0.53 0.2 25)) 25%, transparent); } .ds-pill-pend { background: var(--color-pend-soft, oklch(0.96 0.05 80)); color: var(--color-pend, oklch(0.62 0.13 75)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-pend, oklch(0.62 0.13 75)) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Every elevated container. Hairline border + shadow-sm, 12px radius, panel fill. No hover-lift.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, oklch(0.922 0.004 255)); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-panel, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.03 260 / 0.06), 0 1px 3px oklch(0.2 0.03 260 / 0.05); padding: 1rem; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-panel { padding: 1.25rem; } }

components.name: Roll-Call Table
components.description: The system's base pattern: scannable table of one domain object. The actionable row gets a brand-soft/60 wash (focused); all others recede to hover-only. Exactly one focused row.

components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, oklch(0.922 0.004 255)); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-panel, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.03 260 / 0.06), 0 1px 3px oklch(0.2 0.03 260 / 0.05); } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.24 0.012 260)); } .ds-table thead { background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, oklch(0.922 0.004 255)); text-align: left; } .ds-table th { padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-fg-subtle, oklch(0.6 0.008 255)); } .ds-table td { padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-tr { transition: background-color 150ms; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, oklch(0.922 0.004 255)); } .ds-tr:hover { background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); } .ds-tr-focused, .ds-tr-focused:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-brand-soft, oklch(0.955 0.038 249)) 60%, transparent); } .ds-cell-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, oklch(0.86 0.005 255)); background: var(--color-panel-2, oklch(0.975 0.003 255)); color: var(--color-fg-muted, oklch(0.46 0.01 260)); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Vagas Tally
components.description: The focal element of the call-out detail and the system's one deliberate scale jump. Tabular 30px numeral over a thin fill bar; numeral and bar flip to green (pos) when filled >= total. Width animates on a 150ms ease-out; reduced-motion removes it.
components.html: 4/6vagas
components.css: .ds-tally { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tally-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-tally-num { font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.24 0.012 260)); } .ds-tally-total { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-fg-subtle, oklch(0.6 0.008 255)); } .ds-tally-label { margin-left: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--color-fg-subtle, oklch(0.6 0.008 255)); } .ds-tally-track { width: 7rem; height: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-hairline, oklch(0.922 0.004 255)); } .ds-tally-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-brand, oklch(0.55 0.188 249)); transition: width 150ms ease-out; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tally-fill { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Freela Jobs is a console for getting a shift covered under time pressure. Its reference bar is Linear, Stripe Dashboard, and Vercel Dashboard, and the convention is executed straight: no irony, no quirk, no house-style flourish. Every surface is a scannable table of one domain object with a fixed row anatomy - identity, facts, status, actions - and every detail page is one object in focus above its own sub-list. The grid-of-cards dashboard is refused outright.

The palette is near-neutral grey carrying a single saturated azure accent (hue ~249, deliberately not indigo) plus semantic green / amber / red for outcomes. Depth is a hairline border and a low, soft shadow - never a heavy lifted card. The type face is a workhorse (Geist Sans); counts, times, and phone numbers are set in tabular figures. Light theme is the anchor because the company user works at a counter under hard light; dark theme is fully built, and the professional PWA follows the OS. Forms are inline pages, not modals.

Density is high but not cramped: 8-14 px type does most of the work, controls are 32-36 px tall, and the widest reading column is 6xl. The one moment the system raises its voice is the vagas tally on the call-out detail - a 30 px tabular numeral with a thin fill bar - and it earns that scale by being the single number the manager is waiting on.
keyCharacteristics: Table-first: every index is a hairline table; every detail is a focused object plus a sub-list table.
One azure accent, reserved for the primary action, "now" status, active nav, and the focus ring.
Elevation is hairline + shadow-sm; heavy cards are never used.
Tabular numerals everywhere a number is compared or scanned.
Sentence-case labels; no uppercase kickers or eyebrows.
Light-first, real dark theme, PWA follows the OS.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Azure is the only non-semantic color in the system. It marks the primary action, the "now" status, the active nav item, and the focus ring - nothing else. If a surface has more than one azure element competing for attention, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Status Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red never decorate. A colored pill or number always encodes a domain state (ACCEPTED, NO_SHOW, FILLED, ...). Neutral is the resting state; color is a signal.

rules.name: The Everything-Hairline Rule
rules.body: The default border color for every element is hairline. Reach for hairline-strong only on interactive edges (inputs, secondary buttons, empty states).

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Any figure that is compared or scanned - vaga counts, shift times, phone numbers, the OTP field, ratings - carries the tnum utility (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Prose numbers do not.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Label Rule
rules.body: Labels, section headers, and nav items are sentence case at 12-13 px medium. There are no uppercase kickers, eyebrows, or all-caps headings. The only uppercase in the codebase is the two-letter UF (state) input, normalizing user data - not a type style.

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: text-3xl is reserved for the tally. If a new surface wants a hero number, it needs the same justification: a single value the user is actively waiting on.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Elevation is border-hairline + shadow-sm. If that isn't enough separation, the layout is too dense - fix the spacing, don't add a bigger shadow. Heavy or colored drop shadows are outside the system.

rules.name: The Focused-Row Rule
rules.body: In any roll-call table, the row that is actionable right now (ACCEPTED awaiting attendance, an application awaiting triage) gets focused - a brand-soft/60 wash - and every other row recedes to hover-only. Exactly one emphasis treatment; never more than a wash.

dos: Do build every new index as a Table with the fixed row anatomy: identity, facts, StatusPill, row actions.
Do make each detail page one object in a PageHeader (title + StatusPill + tnum meta line) above its own sub-list table.
Do route colored UI through the semantic tokens (pos/neg/pend/brand) and label enums through src/lib/labels.ts; never print a raw enum.
Do set tnum on counts, times, phone numbers, and codes.
Do use border-hairline + shadow-sm for every elevated surface, and translucency + backdrop-blur-sm for fixed nav.
Do give server-action buttons a SubmitButton with a pendingLabel.
Do keep the primary azure to one element per surface; demote everything else to secondary or ghost.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the .fj-land highlight and tally/bar transitions must resolve to no animation.
donts: Don't build a grid-of-cards dashboard; the list is the product.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or use azure for anything but the primary action, "now" status, active nav, and the focus ring.
Don't use --shadow-md / --shadow-pop, hover-lifts, translateY, or colored drop shadows - elevation is flat + hairline.
Don't add uppercase kickers, eyebrows, or all-caps headings; labels are sentence case at 12-13px.
Don't exceed text-3xl, and reserve that size for a single value the user is actively waiting on.
Don't put more than one focused row in a table.
Don't route /prof/* screens through PageShell/PageHeader; use the compact mobile scaffold + bottom tab bar.
Don't apply Geist Mono; tabular figures come from Geist Sans + tnum.
